note: Each trait's high and low side: the act kinds it pulls toward and away from (OPUS-TRAITS, Oct 12, 2026). 'basis' cites the personality research for both poles. 'anchor' ties a trait to one of the five temperament dimensions at opening generation (standard-score loading; the rest is the person's own part). Pulls and loadings are TUNABLE starting values: loadings sit in the 0.2 to 0.6 range typical of facet-to-domain correlations (Costa & McCrae 1992), checked against that spread.

legislature-v1:showing-their-hand.basis: Self-disclosure in bargaining; Extraversion warmth/assertiveness (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: withholds position (strategic reticence).

people-mind-v1:conflict.basis: Agreeableness compliance, reversed (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: yields and accommodates.

people-mind-v1:deliberation.basis: Decisiveness pole of Conscientiousness deliberation (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: hesitates and checks before acting.

people-mind-v1:reliability.basis: Conscientiousness dutifulness (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: lax about obligations.

people-mind-v1:risk.basis: Extraversion excitement-seeking (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets); Zuckerman 1994 sensation seeking. Low: risk-averse.

people-mind-v1:sociability.basis: Extraversion gregariousness (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: prefers solitude.

personality-v1:action-despite-fear.basis: Neuroticism vulnerability, reversed, with Extraversion assertiveness (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: Timid.

personality-v1:bond-loyalty.basis: Loyalty foundation (Graham et al. 2011); Agreeableness (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: Disloyal.

personality-v1:concern-for-distress.basis: Agreeableness tender-mindedness (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets); BFI-2 Compassion (Soto & John 2017, BFI-2 facets). Low: Callous.

personality-v1:facet-acquisitive.basis: HEXACO Greed Avoidance, reversed (Ashton & Lee 2007, HEXACO facets). Low: indifferent to wealth, shares rather than accumulates.

personality-v1:facet-affectionate.basis: Extraversion warmth (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: reserved and cool with loved ones.

personality-v1:facet-ambitious.basis: Conscientiousness achievement striving (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: content with present standing.

personality-v1:facet-analytical.basis: Openness ideas and Conscientiousness deliberation (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: intuitive, decides on impression.

personality-v1:facet-approval-seeking.basis: Agreeableness compliance and Neuroticism self-consciousness (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: indifferent to others' approval.

personality-v1:facet-arbitrary.basis: Conscientiousness order, reversed (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: consistent, applies the same rule to like cases.

personality-v1:facet-argumentative.basis: Agreeableness compliance, reversed (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: avoids contests over who is right.

personality-v1:facet-assertive.basis: Extraversion assertiveness (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: unassertive, lets others lead.

personality-v1:facet-blunt.basis: Agreeableness straightforwardness and tact (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: cushions and withholds hard conclusions.

personality-v1:facet-brazen.basis: Neuroticism self-consciousness, reversed (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: inhibited by audacity and embarrassment.

personality-v1:facet-brooding.basis: Rumination, Neuroticism depression facet (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets); Nolen-Hoeksema 2000. Low: moves past unpleasant events.

personality-v1:facet-calm.basis: Neuroticism angry hostility and impulsiveness, reversed (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: reactive and quick to escalate.

personality-v1:facet-charming.basis: Extraversion warmth and social boldness (Ashton & Lee 2007, HEXACO facets). Low: socially flat, little pull to engage.

personality-v1:facet-closeness-seeking.basis: Attachment (Fraley et al. 2000) with Extraversion warmth (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: self-reliant in close bonds.

personality-v1:facet-cocky.basis: HEXACO Modesty, reversed (Ashton & Lee 2007, HEXACO facets). Low: modest about own prospects.

personality-v1:facet-comforting.basis: Agreeableness altruism (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: steps back from others' distress.

personality-v1:facet-competitive.basis: Agreeableness compliance, reversed (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets); achievement striving. Low: indifferent to winning.

personality-v1:facet-contented.basis: Achievement striving, reversed (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: dissatisfied, keeps reaching.

personality-v1:facet-cruel.basis: Agreeableness tender-mindedness, reversed (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets); Paulhus & Williams 2002. Low: averse to harming others.

personality-v1:facet-curious.basis: Openness ideas (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets); BFI-2 Intellectual Curiosity (Soto & John 2017, BFI-2 facets). Low: incurious, sticks to the known.

personality-v1:facet-cynical.basis: Agreeableness trust, reversed (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: takes stated ideals at face value.

personality-v1:facet-daydreaming.basis: Openness fantasy (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: stays on the task at hand.

personality-v1:facet-defensive.basis: Neuroticism angry hostility (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: takes criticism without guarding self-image.

personality-v1:facet-deferential.basis: Agreeableness compliance and modesty (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: challenges rank and expertise.

personality-v1:facet-devoted.basis: Commitment (Rusbult 1980) with Agreeableness (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: loosely held commitments.

personality-v1:facet-dramatic.basis: Extraversion and emotional expressivity (Gross & John 1997). Low: understated reactions.

personality-v1:facet-duty-bound.basis: Conscientiousness dutifulness (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: role obligations sit lightly.

personality-v1:facet-enterprising.basis: Holland 1997 Enterprising; Extraversion activity (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: does not start projects.

personality-v1:facet-entitled.basis: HEXACO Modesty, reversed (Ashton & Lee 2007, HEXACO facets); Campbell et al. 2004. Low: expects no special treatment.

personality-v1:facet-envious.basis: Dispositional envy (Smith et al. 1999); Neuroticism (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: unbothered by others' advantage.

personality-v1:facet-excitable.basis: Extraversion positive emotions (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: subdued toward new chances.

personality-v1:facet-fair-minded.basis: HEXACO Fairness (Ashton & Lee 2007, HEXACO facets); fairness foundation (Graham et al. 2011). Low: treats like cases by convenience.

personality-v1:facet-fickle.basis: Conscientiousness, reversed (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: steady preferences and allegiances.

personality-v1:facet-forgiving.basis: HEXACO Forgiveness (Ashton & Lee 2007, HEXACO facets). Low: holds grievances after repair.

personality-v1:facet-friendly.basis: Extraversion warmth (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: cool, reserved opening manner.

personality-v1:facet-generous.basis: Agreeableness altruism (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: keeps resources and time.

personality-v1:facet-gentle.basis: HEXACO Gentleness (Ashton & Lee 2007, HEXACO facets). Low: rough, pushes hard in disagreement.

personality-v1:facet-guarded.basis: Agreeableness trust and Extraversion warmth, reversed (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: open with intentions.

personality-v1:facet-hostile.basis: Neuroticism angry hostility (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: begins exchanges in good faith.

personality-v1:facet-hot-headed.basis: Neuroticism angry hostility and impulsiveness (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: slow to escalate.

personality-v1:facet-humble.basis: HEXACO Modesty (Ashton & Lee 2007, HEXACO facets). Low: claims credit and status.

personality-v1:facet-imaginative.basis: Openness fantasy (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: concrete, sticks to the actual.

personality-v1:facet-independent.basis: Autonomy need (Deci & Ryan 2000). Low: prefers shared direction.

personality-v1:facet-informal.basis: Conscientiousness order, reversed (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: formal, keeps ceremony.

personality-v1:facet-intimacy-guarded.basis: Attachment avoidance (Fraley et al. 2000). Low: comfortable with closeness.

personality-v1:facet-inventive.basis: Openness ideas; BFI-2 Creative Imagination (Soto & John 2017, BFI-2 facets). Low: uses the established way.

personality-v1:facet-light-hearted.basis: Neuroticism depression, reversed (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: setbacks weigh heavily.

personality-v1:facet-manipulative.basis: Machiavellianism (Christie & Geis 1970); HEXACO Sincerity, reversed (Ashton & Lee 2007, HEXACO facets). Low: persuades openly.

personality-v1:facet-mediating.basis: Agreeableness compliance and altruism (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: stays out of others' disputes.

personality-v1:facet-meticulous.basis: Conscientiousness order (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: careless with detail.

personality-v1:facet-mischievous.basis: Playfulness (Proyer 2017); Conscientiousness, reversed. Low: keeps small boundaries.

personality-v1:facet-nostalgic.basis: Nostalgia proneness (Routledge et al. 2008). Low: oriented to the present and future.

personality-v1:facet-nurturing.basis: Agreeableness altruism and tender-mindedness (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: leaves others to their own growth.

personality-v1:facet-observant.basis: Openness actions and Conscientiousness deliberation (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: inattentive to cues, acts on surface.

personality-v1:facet-open-minded.basis: Openness values (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: dismisses unfamiliar explanations.

personality-v1:facet-opportunistic.basis: Openness actions and Extraversion activity (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: sticks to the plan.

personality-v1:facet-persistent.basis: Conscientiousness self-discipline (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets); grit (Duckworth et al. 2007). Low: gives up after setbacks.

personality-v1:facet-philanthropic.basis: Agreeableness altruism (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets); Bekkers & Wiepking 2011. Low: little voluntary giving.

personality-v1:facet-polite.basis: BFI-2 Respectfulness (Soto & John 2017, BFI-2 facets). Low: ignores courtesies.

personality-v1:facet-practical.basis: Openness, reversed; Conscientiousness (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: chases infeasible plans.

personality-v1:facet-proud.basis: Authentic/hubristic pride (Tracy & Robins 2007). Low: little stake in dignity or recognition.

personality-v1:facet-restless.basis: Extraversion excitement-seeking (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets); boredom proneness (Farmer & Sundberg 1986). Low: content with routine.

personality-v1:facet-sassy.basis: Extraversion assertiveness with low compliance (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: lets remarks pass.

personality-v1:facet-self-conscious.basis: Neuroticism self-consciousness (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: unconcerned with being watched.

personality-v1:facet-self-serving.basis: HEXACO Honesty-Humility, reversed (Ashton & Lee 2007, HEXACO facets). Low: weighs others' benefit with own.

personality-v1:facet-sensitive.basis: Neuroticism vulnerability (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets); Aron & Aron 1997. Low: unshaken by social cues.

personality-v1:facet-shy.basis: Shyness (Cheek & Buss 1981); Extraversion, reversed (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: at ease with strangers.

personality-v1:facet-sincere.basis: HEXACO Sincerity (Ashton & Lee 2007, HEXACO facets). Low: says what suits the moment.

personality-v1:facet-skeptical.basis: Agreeableness trust, reversed; need for cognition (Cacioppo & Petty 1982). Low: credulous.

personality-v1:facet-slow-to-warm-up.basis: Temperament approach-withdrawal (Thomas & Chess 1977). Low: warms quickly.

personality-v1:facet-smug.basis: HEXACO Modesty, reversed (Ashton & Lee 2007, HEXACO facets). Low: unsatisfied with own record, keeps improving.

personality-v1:facet-studious.basis: Openness ideas and Conscientiousness self-discipline (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: avoids sustained study.

personality-v1:facet-supportive.basis: Agreeableness altruism (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: leaves others to recover alone.

personality-v1:facet-tactful.basis: Agreeableness straightforwardness and politeness (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: tactless, speaks regardless of harm.

personality-v1:facet-teasing.basis: Playfulness (Proyer 2017); Keltner et al. 2001 on teasing. Low: earnest, avoids playful challenge.

personality-v1:facet-tender-hearted.basis: Agreeableness tender-mindedness (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: meets hurt with anger.

personality-v1:facet-thrill-seeking.basis: Extraversion excitement-seeking (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets); Zuckerman 1994. Low: avoids stimulation.

personality-v1:facet-vindictive.basis: HEXACO Forgiveness, reversed (Ashton & Lee 2007, HEXACO facets); McCullough et al. 2001. Low: lets grievances go.

personality-v1:facet-work-centered.basis: Workaholism (Clark et al. 2016); Conscientiousness achievement striving (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: work stays bounded.

personality-v1:facet-zealous.basis: Conviction strength (Skitka 2010); Extraversion activity. Low: holds convictions loosely.

personality-v1:initial-trust.basis: Agreeableness trust (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: Suspicious.

personality-v1:method-revision.basis: Openness actions (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: Stubborn.

personality-v1:patience.basis: Conscientiousness deliberation; delay discounting (Frederick et al. 2002). Low: Impatient.

personality-v1:self-confidence.basis: Neuroticism self-consciousness, reversed; self-esteem (Rosenberg 1965). Low: Insecure.

personality-v1:truthfulness.basis: HEXACO Sincerity (Ashton & Lee 2007, HEXACO facets). Low: Deceitful.

personality-v1:voluntary-effort.basis: Conscientiousness self-discipline (Costa & McCrae 1992, NEO-PI-R facets). Low: Effort-averse.
